content: WRC official scoring rules and yaku sheet: open hands still require at least one yaku because dora is not yaku; calls remove riichi, ippatsu, menzen tsumo, pinfu and iipeikou eligibility; kuitan and yakuhai remain valid open; ittsuu, sanshoku doujun and chanta fall 2 to 1 han, honitsu 3 to 2, junchan 3 to 2, chinitsu 6 to 5; melded groups and quads use lower fu than concealed equivalents; rinshan and chankan are one-han yaku.
